name: Cookies Addons Embed Video
description: COOKiES add-on text-format filter that blocks YouTube video iframes in formatted text by moving their src to data-src until consent, deferring to the COOKiES Video module's placeholder.
project_description: Submodule of Cookies Addons. Provides the 'Block YouTube videos' text-format filter plugin (cookies_addons_embed_video_filter) that rewrites YouTube <iframe> src attributes to data-src so YouTube embeds do not load until consent is given; it attaches the COOKiES Video module's cookies_video_embed_field library, which renders the placeholder and restores the video on consent. Depends on the cookies_video submodule of COOKiES. Enable the filter in a text format's settings.
